class.name: JRPGSceneManager
class.brief_description: Plays a JRPG's maps: the running game, the current map, transfers between maps and map music.
class.description: A game scene has one scene manager, usually as its root. While a game runs it holds the game state ([JRPGGameState]), shows the current map as an instance of its scene (found through the map list, under the manager's other children), moves the player between maps with [method transfer], fading through black or white, and plays each map's autoplay BGM and BGS. While a game runs it runs the game's loop at a fixed 60 steps a second on the game state's simulation clock: each step moves the player ([method get_player]) as the direction actions say, keeps the game state's player position, and counts the steps taken. The player's camera, the one the game is seen through, stays inside the map (its area on the canvas, seen through the camera's zoom); a map smaller than the screen stays in the middle of it. On a looping axis the camera is free, but the map is drawn once: the looping display comes with a later version. When it enters a running game's tree (not in the editor) with [member autostart] on, it starts a new game at the System start position, after every [method Node._ready] call: a script that continues a loaded game there with [method resume] comes first. A transfer that cannot happen (a map the map list lacks, a scene that cannot load or is not a map, a cell outside the map) leaves the player where they are, prints one warning and returns an error. Authority: in a single-player game the manager decides transfers itself; online, the server decides them and the client's manager only applies what it is told.

method.name: get_bgm_player
method.description: Returns the player of the map's background music.

method.name: get_bgs_player
method.description: Returns the player of the map's background sound (ambience).

method.name: get_cell_cache
method.description: Returns the current map's cell cache: what each cell means for movement.

method.name: get_database
method.description: Returns the database the game runs with: the one given with [method set_database], or the one loaded from [member database_path] once a game starts.

method.name: get_fade_amount
method.description: Returns how opaque the transfer fade is now, from [code]0.0[/code] (clear) to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_game_state
method.description: Returns the state of the running game, or [code]null[/code] before a game starts.

method.name: get_map
method.description: Returns the current map's scene instance, or [code]null[/code] before a game starts.

method.name: get_map_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the current map in the map list.

method.name: get_map_list
method.description: Returns the map list maps are found through: the one given with [method set_map_list], or the one loaded from [member map_list_path] once a map is needed.

method.name: get_player
method.description: Returns the player's character, inside the current map once a game runs.

method.name: is_transferring
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a transfer is fading out or in.

method.name: refresh_player_character
method.description: Draws the player as the party leader's character again, after the party or that actor's character changed.

method.name: resume
method.description: Continues [param game_state], a loaded game, attaching the database to it when it has none: shows its map at its player position, without a fade. Saved states of events the map no longer has are dropped, and a map edited since the save is reported with one warning. When the saved map or position no longer exists, the game continues at the System start position with one warning.

method.name: run_steps
method.description: Runs [param steps] simulation steps now, as that many sixtieths of a second of frames would: the player steps as the held actions say. Fails when no game runs.

method.name: set_database
method.description: Sets the database the game runs with, instead of the one at [member database_path].

method.name: set_map_list
method.description: Sets the map list maps are found through, instead of the one at [member map_list_path].

method.name: start_new_game
method.description: Starts a new game from the database and shows the System start position without a fade. [param seed] seeds the game's random numbers; [code]-1[/code] picks a random seed. Fails when System data has no start position or the start map cannot be shown.

method.name: transfer
method.description: Moves the player to [param cell] of map [param map_id], facing [param direction] (a [enum JRPGSystemData.Direction], or [constant DIRECTION_RETAIN] to keep their facing), through [param fade]. With a fade, the map changes at the darkest point and the transfer ends when the fade has cleared ([signal transfer_finished]). Moving within the current map keeps its scene instance as it is. A map the map list lacks, a scene that cannot load or is not a map, or a cell outside the map leaves the player where they are with one warning, and so does a transfer asked for while another is under way; the error says which.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], a new game starts when the manager enters a running game's tree, unless a game was given before then.
The database file loaded when no database was given with [method set_database].
The map list file loaded when no map list was given with [method set_map_list].

signal.name: map_entered
signal.description: Emitted when map [param map_id] is shown with the player on it: at once without a fade, at the darkest point with one.

signal.name: transfer_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a transfer with a fade has cleared, the player on map [param map_id].

constants.constant: The transfer fades out to black and back in.
The transfer fades out to white and back in.
For [method transfer]: the player keeps facing the way they face.
